initialize_torchcomms_backend: initialize a PyTorchTorchCommsBackend with bootstrap_info and commsParams to set up torchcomms-based distributed communication
run_all_reduce_collective: run an all_reduce collective operation across ranks using the torchcomms backend with sum or max reduce ops
create_process_groups: create process groups via torchcomms split communicators by calling initialize_groups with synchronized group rank mappings
execute_p2p_async_ops: execute async point-to-point send and recv operations using isend and irecv methods on the torchcomms backend
allocate_random_tensors: allocate random tensors on a specified device with a given dtype and optional scale factor using alloc_random
